terminal_conclusion.cargo_affected_by_confirmed_python_defec: Not established; ordinary Cargo source lacks the known triggering close-all sweep. Actual Cargo native gate is the next discriminating observation.
terminal_conclusion.reason: Cargo FD jobserver forces fork through pre_exec, but fork itself is not the confirmed trigger. Its callback changes flags on two owned FDs only; Rust do_exec performs stdio/credential/cwd/signal setup and callbacks then execvp, without enumerating/closing arbitrary other descriptors.
terminal_conclusion.python_child_coverage: Still unmet; build scripts are arbitrary programs and can themselves launch Python or explicit close-all descendants. A tiny Cargo pass cannot dispose of that requirement.

exact_identities.cargo_identity_proof: Rust1.95.0 src/tools/cargo submodule and Cargo rust-1.95.0 branch commit agree in retained API trees.

source_observations.finding: Rust Command::spawn first calls posix_spawn; fallback forks and child calls do_exec. posix_spawn rejects nonempty pre_exec closure list.

Rust ordinary do_exec does stdio dup2, optional credentials/chroot/cwd/process-group/session changes, signals, configured callbacks and execvp. This complete function contains no closefrom/close_range/FD-directory loop. Narrow drops/owned FD cleanup and kernel close-on-successful-exec are not a Python pre-exec close-all sweep. User pre_exec callbacks may perform additional work; no universal Rust-child guarantee.
Cargo ProcessBuilder build_command_without_args calls jobserver Client.configure when jobserver attached. Both rustc process preparation and custom build execution attach the build runner jobserver.

No inherited jobserver => Cargo creates Client::new and acquires its own token. On nonLinux Unix new client uses pipe and CLOEXEC FDs. Its configure installs pre_exec clearing CLOEXEC for exactly read/write. FIFO-auth configure returns without pre_exec. Linux-only inherited FD-to-FIFO optimization must not be generalized to macOS. Actual inherited auth changes path, so native gate must record it.

Build scripts are separately compiled/executed Cargo programs with jobserver environment; they can spawn arbitrary children and configure their own descriptor policies. Jobserver inheritance does not normalize all descendant spawning.
